episode_summary: This episode features a live coaching session with Michael Opyd, focusing on overcoming personal challenges and regaining motivation in real estate. Michael emphasizes the importance of consistency in routines and connecting with one's 'why' to pull through difficult times. The session provides actionable insights for agents feeling stuck, particularly after personal loss.
